what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In person at the Bilotta Meeting Room, Town Hall; remote option via Zoom (https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9091740347?omn=83697202012, Meeting ID 909 174 0347, phone (888) 475-4499) as a courtesy; also broadcast on Lunenburg Public Access, Facebook Live and YouTube.

items.agenda_line: • **Common Victualler License for Kiku, Inc. d/b/a Kiku Asian Cuisine located at 50 Massachusetts
items.why_it_matters: A licensing hearing for a restaurant at 50 Massachusetts Avenue, a local business permit residents may care about.

items.agenda_line: • Discussion on Future of the Tri-board
items.why_it_matters: The Tri-board is where town and school boards meet on budget matters, so its future affects how budgets are coordinated.

items.agenda_line: • Discussion of Additions/Modifications to Bylaws Ch. 12 Boards, Commissions, and Committees
items.why_it_matters: Possible changes to the town bylaw governing how boards, commissions and committees are set up.

items.agenda_line: • Status of Polling Location for November 3, 2026 Election
items.why_it_matters: Tells voters where they will vote on election day.
The Select Board is preparing for a Special Town Meeting where residents vote on the warrant articles.
The draft list of articles for the Special Town Meeting is under review.

items.agenda_line: o Select Board Sponsored Warrant Article(s)
items.why_it_matters: The Board may discuss articles it will put before Town Meeting.
A service residents use is being moved to a new location.

items.agenda_line: • Opioid Settlement Funds: Use for AEDs in All Town/School Buildings and Police/Fire Vehicles
items.why_it_matters: Discusses spending opioid settlement money on defibrillators in town and school buildings and public safety vehicles.

items.agenda_line: • Select Board Liaison for Personnel Committee and Any Necessary Liaison Reassignment(s)
items.why_it_matters: Board members may be assigned as liaisons to the Personnel Committee, which deals with town employment matters.
A discussion about the town's municipal buildings, which could bear on facilities and future spending.

preview.hook: Opioid-settlement money for AEDs, the Special Town Meeting warrant, and the future of the Tri-board
preview.one_line: Select Board, Oct 6, 7 PM, hybrid: Special Town Meeting draft warrant, opioid funds for AEDs, Tri-board future, food pantry move and municipal buildings.
